title: Client Dashboard Sprint
subtitle: Your data is in a file. The client QBR is tomorrow. Build a live interactive dashboard instead of sending another deck.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: 4 sheets: Revenue Summary (scorecard + regions + product mix), Monthly Revenue (Jan–Dec), Client Risk Table (10 clients, renewal risk), Pipeline (Q1 2025 forecast)
Genpact brand logo — attach so the AI embeds it in the dashboard header
Design system: indigo #4F46E5, Inter typography weights, tile component patterns — attach so the AI matches this visual standard
Target dashboard layout: 4-tile scorecard above fold, 2-column chart grid, client risk table — attach so the AI matches this layout

learning_objectives: Frame the problem before writing any prompt — decide what to build, for whom, and what decision it must enable
Write your own AI prompt using a 5-area scaffold: audience, data, design, what to build, output rules
Test your first output against the data file — verify at least 3 figures before you iterate
Improve with one targeted follow-up instead of re-prompting from scratch
Deliver a self-contained HTML file that opens in any browser — no install, no server, no dependencies
